request.system:
You are the onboarding assistant for Relay, a team-collaboration product made by Lumen Labs. You help the admin of a customer account set up their workspace.

Use the tools to look up the account's setup status and to search the help centre, and answer the admin's questions about setting up Relay.

If the admin asks for a person, or asks about pricing, contracts, refunds or legal matters, hand off to a human with create_handoff.

Be helpful and concise.

messages.content: What is the maximum file size for attachments on a card?

content.content:
{"query": "attachment file size limit card", "note": "At least one article covers this question.", "articles": [{"slug": "bulk-invite", "title": "Invite many users at once (bulk invite)", "score": 6.43, "coverage": 0.6, "covers_question": true, "text": "# Invite many users at once (bulk invite)

To add many people at once, go to Admin settings, Users, Invite, and choose Upload a file. Upload a CSV file with one column named email. You can add an optional column named role with the value member or admin.

Relay checks the file first and shows you any addresses it cannot use (wrong format, already a user, or more rows than free seats). Nothing is sent until you confirm.

There is no limit on the size of the file other than the number of seats you have free.

Search keywords: add whole team everyone all at once many people dozen dozens hundreds list import upload
"}, {"slug": "automation-rules", "title": "Automation rules", "score": 3.06, "coverage": 0.4, "covers_question": false, "text": "# Automation rules

An automation rule does something for you when something happens on a board. Example: when a card moves to Done, notify the reporter. Create rules from the Automation button on any board: choose a trigger, optional conditions, and one or more actions.

Rules also work with recurring cards: the rule runs each time a new copy of the card is created.

The number of rules per workspace depends on your edition: 5 on Free, 15 on Standard, 60 on Premium, and no practical limit on Enterprise. When you reach the limit, existing rules keep running but you cannot add new ones.

Search keywords: automate automation rule rules trigger action limit
"}, {"slug": "export-board", "title": "Export a board to a spreadsheet", "score": 2.09, "coverage": 0.4, "covers_question": false, "text": "# Export a board to a spreadsheet

To export a board, open it, choose the menu at the top right, then Export, then CSV. The file has one row per card with its list, title, assignee, labels, due date and the date it was last changed. Archived cards are included only if you tick Include archived.

For a monthly report, save the export with the same filter each time, or connect the cloud drive integration to have the export written to a shared folder automatically.
"}]}

tools.name: get_account_context
tools.description: Facts about the customer's account: edition, seats, lifecycle stage, health score and its components, open tickets, latest NPS score. Call it when the answer depends on the customer's edition or situation.

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.description: Which of the four setup steps the account has completed (first board, five users, an integration, single sign-on) and which are still missing. Call it first in an onboarding conversation.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Relay help centre. Returns the best-matching articles with their full text. Answer product questions only from what this returns.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words.

tools.name: create_handoff
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human, with a summary. Use it when the customer asks for a person, asks about pricing, contracts, refunds or legal matters, is upset, or when the help centre does not answer the question.

summary.description: What the customer wants and what was already tried.

tools.name: log_outcome
tools.description: Record how the conversation ended. Call it once, at the end.

note.description: One sentence on what was resolved.

input.summary: Admin asked for the maximum file size for attachments on a card. The help centre search found no article about card attachment limits. The only match was about the CSV file used for bulk invites, which is a different thing.
input.recommended_next_step: Tell the admin the card attachment size limit (and whether it depends on edition), and consider adding it to the help centre.

input.note: The help centre doesn't give the card attachment size limit, so the question was handed off to a human.
